MemoryBlowup.RootCause: dnSpy 863effcee: a RECURSIVE lambda (a handler that subscribes itself - Knx.Ets.Common arx/b::c and UserControls ContextMenuPlacementBehavior/<>c__DisplayClass2_0::method_0). Inlining copies the body into its own body, so the AST grows without bound. Fixed by IsInLambdaCycle (walks the lambda's ldftn targets, memoized) plus relaxed backstop caps.
MemoryBlowup.Found: 2026-09-27: with '--no-anon-methods' the same module exported in 40 s at 3 GB, so lambda inlining is the trigger - it copies each lambda's AST into its call site and generated code creates hundreds per method.
